Verified for Slack 4.51.191 with the version-gated Tier D Compatibility Shim. AppMux patches only the managed copy after exact executable, app.asar, Electron fuse, singleton, and external-link signature checks. Native sign-in uses an isolated AuthBrowser and a memory-only private callback pipe to the existing Slack instance; the installed original and its slack:// handler remain unchanged.

Verified for Figma 126.8.16 with a version-gated owner-host Compatibility Shim. AppMux verifies the signed Figma executable, archive, native modules, FigmaAgent, and Electron 42.9.2, uses a private user-data root and WebView2 authentication profile, and returns packaged figma protocol activation through the one waiting private pipe. The installed original and vendor handler remain unchanged.
Unverified: Electron apps typically resolve AppData via the shell API, which ignores env redirection.
The desktop package declares appLicensing and stores auth outside Chromium's profile. AppMux uses the verified official web app for compliant multi-account isolation.
Claude's packaged CoworkVMService is system-wide. Package Lab can create a service-free chat instance; Cowork/VM is disabled and native browser/Office integration may remain shared.
Spotify's desktop singleton prevents side-by-side instances. AppMux uses the verified official web player for simultaneous accounts.
